C212.notes: SER AF-ER-001. Photo confirmed (no text drip). Reverse greater kudu left · STATE OF ERITREA · 1997 · 50 · FIFTY CENTS. First-year nakfa coinage — independence 1993, currency introduced 1997; Asmara / market / bus odd-change in a brand-new money. Country #37 — first Eritrea / first Horn of Africa (after Nigeria C201 / AF-NG-001 West Africa). Eritrea flips now 1.

open_questions: The design note says the obverse shows the State of Eritrea arms / a camel, but the Numista entry (N#2403) shows soldiers with a flag on the common side. Which is right? Check the design note against the entry and the photo.

C212.story: A 1997 50 cents from Eritrea. One side shows a greater kudu with the value 50; the other side shows soldiers raising the national flag, with the words LIBERTY EQUALITY JUSTICE and the year 1991. Struck in nickel-clad steel.
